plan: A mage who places dark spheres and hurls them at her enemies for a huge explosion.
aSurveiller: Her R (Unleashed Power). All her spheres strike one champion: the more there are, the more it hurts.
contrer: Stay away from the spheres: her E pushes them and stuns.
When low on health, stay out of range: her R can kill you in one go.
Engage her: she is fragile and immobile.
faiblesses: Has to place her spheres first.

sorts.W: Grabs and throws a sphere or a minion.
sorts.E: Pushes and stuns with the spheres.
